title: edge-reference-check profile
description: A level-1 profile: a named list of checks evaluated against a collect.sh bundle. Profiles are data, not code.

kind.description: editorial: this project's opinion. publisher: what the OS publisher claims for a named (OS, platform). operator: a profile an operator wrote for their own fleet.

source.description: Where the claims in this profile come from.

why.description: One sentence. Shown next to a FAIL.

source.description: key: a KEY line from the bundle. config: a CONFIG_ option from the config section. cmdline: the kernel command line.

key.description: For source=key: the key name, e.g. selinux, ima_appraise, sysctl.kernel.kptr_restrict.

expect.description: Exact expected value. For config, 'y', 'm', 'n' ('n' means the option is not set or absent).

match.description: ECMAScript regular expression the value must match. Used instead of expect.

any_of.description: The value must equal one of these.
